citations.title: Acorn Workspace Support
citations.text:
# Acorn Workspace Support

This is fictional support content for repeatable evaluation, not a real service policy.

The Acorn Workspace trial lasts 14 days. No credit card is required to start the trial.

Support is available Monday through Friday, from 09:00 to 17:00 in the America/Vancouver time zone.

To export your workspace, open Settings, choose Export, and select JSON or Markdown. Exported files are downloaded to your computer.

These instructions describe the standard service. Enterprise contracts have separate terms and are not part of this support collection.

citations.title: Acorn Workspace Billing
citations.text:
# Acorn Workspace Billing

This is fictional billing content for repeatable evaluation, not a real service policy.

Standard annual subscriptions have a 30-day refund request window, measured from the original purchase date. Send a refund request to billing@acorn.example and include the purchase receipt.

This document does not specify how long banks take to post an approved refund, or what happens to refund requests after the standard request window expires.

Billing records and workspace content are separate. Export instructions are in the Acorn Workspace Support document.
